test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following events happened in 1950?

options.text: First National Agricultural Policy was adopted
The Planning Commission was set up

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Planning Commission was set up**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Planning Commission was set up** in India in the year 1950.
 
• The Planning Commission was an institution in the Government of India, which formulated India's Five-Year Plans, among other functions.
 
• Its primary task was to oversee the entire process of planning, development, and resource allocation in the country.
 
• It played a crucial role in the economic development and modernization of India during its operational period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Planning Commission** was established by a resolution of the Government of India in March 1950.
 
• It was chaired by the Prime Minister and included various experts and officials as its members.
 
• The Commission was dissolved in 2014 and replaced by the **NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)**, which serves a similar advisory role but with a different structure and mandate.
 
• The Planning Commission's establishment marked a significant step in India's efforts towards planned economic development post-independence.
